title: DESI and Dynamical Dark Energy from Extended Pre-geometric Gravity
summary: We consider the simplest quadratic extension of MacDowell--Mansouri pre-geometric gravity that preserves the topological pre-volume-form symmetry. Upon symmetry breaking, the theory reduces to $(\mathrm{Lovelock})^2$ gravity and admits a Galileon-like Horndeski scalar-tensor representation. The gravitational Higgs mechanism relates the Gauss--Bonnet coupling to the bare cosmological constant, while the quadratic correction elevates the gravitational $θ$-angle to a dynamical gravi-axion whose ultra-light mass scale can drive late-time acceleration.
